paper_title: PromptMind Team at EHRSQL-2024 Improving Reliability of SQL Generation   using Ensemble LLMs
caption: Individual vs Ensemble Models
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between the cost and the score reliability cost for different ensemble models. The x-axis is labeled "Cost" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 10, with tick labels spaced at increments of 1. The y-axis is labeled “Reliability Cost” and uses a linear scale ranging from 20 to approximately 35, with tick labels spaced at increments of 5. A blue line, representing the 3-Model Ensemble, begins at a score reliability cost of approximately 80 and steadily decreases to a score reliability cost of approximately 60 across the x-axis. A red line, indicating the 2-Model Ensemble, begins at a score reliability cost of approximately 70 and similarly decreases to a score reliability cost of approximately 60 across the x-axis. Finally, a gold line, representing the GPT-4 model, begins at a score reliability cost of approximately 75 and decreases to a score reliability cost of approximately 50 across the x-axis.
